videos.caption: Meet Athena, the rufous bettong!  Bettongs are small, shy, native marsupials that most people, including many Australians, have never heard of. They are extremely vulnerable to predation by cats and foxes and sadly their numbers continue to decline through much of their range.  Bettongs have prehensile tails and use them to collect bunches of grass that they build nests from.  Australia has many unique mammal species but we also have the highest mammal extinction rate in the world.  • • • • #bettong #cute #adorable #animalfacts #wildlife
